name: Shizuku
source:
"Master, you're human!"

A half-human, half-demon beast that became Raoul's familiar. He's perverse and cheeky. Even there he's wary of Raoul, he seems to get along well with Arles despite their opposing personalities.

[Translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/kuro/game/tukai/t_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
